verdict.rationale: Square documents online card acceptance through the Card Payments API, the Web Payments SDK, and prebuilt eCommerce integrations that it says can be connected "in just a few clicks." Its docs also say personal access tokens are suitable for production on your own account, which points to a short setup path. However, nothing in the evidence addresses account approval, verification, or how long it takes to go from signup to a first live payment. Missing for 10: documented signup-to-first-live-payment timeline, account activation/verification requirements, independent or hands-on corroboration of same-day acceptance.
